title: Smoke
description: A rising plume of smoke advected by curl noise. Particles pour off a source and get carried by a swirling, low-divergence flow field plus buoyant rise and wind, then swell and thin as they climb. Each particle is a soft blob; stacked, they read as a curling column of smoke against the dark. Keep it grey, or tint the whole plume any hue. Emission, rise, turbulence, wind, source width, persistence, density and tint are live; the mic feeds the emission and each beat sends up a puff. Drag to steer the source around.
